observations: Three photos show a large quantity of used vehicle tire pressure monitoring system (TPMS) sensors.
Photo 0: A pile of TPMS sensors on a wooden surface. Some have white plastic caps, others have red or black caps. Some show visible wear, dirt, and corrosion on the metal stems.
Photo 1: A pile of TPMS sensors in a mesh sack. Most have black plastic housings with green stickers. Many show dirt, grime, and rust on the metal stems.
Photo 2: A close-up of TPMS sensors on a blue surface. The sensors are black with green stickers. The metal stems show significant rust and wear.
No branding or model numbers are legible on any sensor in any photo.
The sensors appear to be a mix of different types, possibly from different vehicle makes or models.
The condition varies: some look relatively clean, others are heavily corroded.

identity.kind: vehicle tyre pressure monitoring system (TPMS) sensors

claims.evidence: The photos show many TPMS sensors, but 'all' is an unverifiable claim. The photos do not show every possible type or model, nor do they confirm availability of every type. The term 'cesor' is likely a typo for 'sensor'.

risks.risk: Sensors may be non-functional due to battery depletion, internal damage, or corrosion.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the sensor's electronic circuit board or a test report showing the sensor is working.

risks.risk: Sensors may be incompatible with specific vehicle makes or models.
risks.proof: A clear photo showing the brand and model number on the sensor, or a list of compatible vehicles.

risks.risk: Corrosion on the metal stems may prevent proper installation or cause leaks.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the stem and valve interface, showing no rust or damage.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photos of the brand and model number on the sensors, if any.
Photos showing the condition of the sensor's internal electronics or circuit board.
A test report or video showing a sensor working properly.
Photos of the stem and valve interface to check for corrosion or damage.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as vehicle TPMS sensors. While the seller's claim of 'all available' is unverified, the photos confirm a large quantity of used sensors. The risks of non-functionality, incompatibility, and corrosion are present but can be priced at worst case (non-working, generic, damaged). The item can be priced based on its worst-case condition as seen.
